move: Waddle with {move_left} and {move_right}. Keep going to break into a run!
jump: Press {jump} to jump. Hold it longer to jump higher.
flap: In the air, press {jump} again to flap. Three flaps, then hold it to glide.
honk: Press {honk_primary} to HONK. Honks ring chimes and shake treats out of bushes.
eat: Stand by a snack bowl and press {eat_interact} to eat. Snacks give Tato powers!
power: With a snack in your pocket, {honk_primary} uses its power instead of a plain honk.
swap: {ability_swap} swaps between pocket A, pocket B and a plain honk.
fuse: Two different snacks? Press {fusion} to fuse them into a recipe.
slide: Hold {move_down} while running to belly-slide. Wheee!
drop: On thin planks, hold {move_down} and press {jump} to drop through.
swim: Tato floats! Paddle with {move_left} and {move_right}, and {jump} hops out.
station: A snack station! Touch it to rest. If Tato gets bonked too often, you come back here.
pepper: Spicy Pepper makes a Fire Honk. Warm things up: wax melts, braziers light.
bubble: Bubbleberry makes a Bubble Float. Drift up, steer, and press {jump} to pop out.
updraft: Warm air rises. A bubble in warm air goes up, up, up!
steam: Carry Pepper AND Bubbleberry, then press {fusion}: Steam Lift!
thorns: Brambles are prickly. They pop bubbles, too.
exit: Ring the golden dinner bell to finish the stage.
hint: Stuck? Press {hint} for the Hint Nest. It never costs anything.
